value.value: Measure PL from 80 to 430 K. Fit spectra with Lorentzian functions and extract PL peak energy, FWHM and intensity. The observed trend changes are assigned to γ-tetragonal-1 → β-tetragonal-2 at 140 K and β → α-cubic at 250 K. These are source interpretations supported by optical/Raman trends, not variable-temperature coordinate refinements on the QDs.
